title: Bounded constructible complexes under a proper direct image
statement:
Let $b:Y\to S$ be proper
between finite-type $k$-schemes, with the finite coefficients of
[sbc-def-coefficient-conventions].
For an ordinary derived
complex $K\in\hyperref[def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]{D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)}$,
its derived direct image
$Rb_*K$ belongs to $D^b_c(S,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Choose $a\leq c$ with $\mathcal H^qK=0$ for $q\notin[a,c]$ by the bounded-constructible definition. The proper morphism $b$ is finite type, and $S$ is quasi-compact since its structure morphism is finite type. Apply [lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound] to get $d\geq0$ bounding ordinary fibre dimensions. Apply [lem-sc-fibre-dimension-after-base-change] to $\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(s)}\to S$: every local dimension of the geometric fibre agrees with the local dimension of the ordinary fibre at its image, hence is at most $d$. By [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions], the global dimension of each geometric fibre is the supremum of these local dimensions, so is at most $d$. The same cited statement covers an empty fibre, whose dimension is $-\infty$.

source.place: Tag 0A3V (lemma-morphism-finite-type-bounded-dimension) and Tag 02FY (lemma-dimension-fibre-after-base-change); blueprint proof paragraph 1; Topology Tag 0B7I (lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions)

proof.text: Work with the constant-ring module categories on $Y_{\Et}$ and $S_{\Et}$, in a universe large enough that these sites and ring values are small. They are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaves-grothendieck], and $b_*$ is additive and left exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. Their module sheaf categories have enough injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. Choose a bounded below K-injective representative $I$ for $K$, with $I^q=0$ for $q<a$, by [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to this representative and $v=b_*$, whose right derived functor is $Rb_*$ as defined in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. We obtain $E_2^{p,q}=R^pb_*\mathcal H^q(K)\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rb_*K)$, zero for $p<0$, with stabilization and the specified finite exhaustive separated abutment filtration and graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}$.

source.place: ## Proof, paragraph 1, hypercohomology sequence; expanded verification of its hypotheses

proof.text: Each $\mathcal H^q(K)$ is a constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf. The proper morphism $b$, finite-type target $S$, and geometric fibre bound $d$ meet the hypotheses of [thm-fin-proper-case]. Therefore $R^pb_*\mathcal H^q(K)$ is constructible for $p\geq0$ and is zero for $p>2d$. Together with step 2 and the cohomology support of $K$, the $E_2$ page is zero outside the rectangle $0\leq p\leq2d$, $a\leq q\leq c$.

Induct on the page number. Given constructible entries on $E_r$, the kernel of each outgoing differential is constructible by [thm-constructible-serre]; the image of the incoming differential is the kernel of its cokernel, so is constructible by the same kernel and cokernel clauses. Taking their quotient, again a cokernel, makes $E_{r+1}$ constructible. Entries outside the rectangle stay zero, since each next entry is a subquotient of the corresponding previous entry. Stabilization in [thm-sp-truncation-e2] identifies each $E_\infty$ entry with a finite page, hence it is constructible. The same theorem gives each $H^n=\mathcal H^n(Rb_*K)$ a finite exhaustive separated filtration with these graded pieces. Starting from its zero final term and using the extension clause of [thm-constructible-serre] on each short exact sequence of successive filtration terms shows $H^n$ is constructible.

source.place: ## Proof, paragraph 2, kernels/cokernels and finite-filtration sentences

proof.text: For $n<a$ or $n>c+2d$, no pair $(p,q)$ in the rectangle has $p+q=n$. Thus every graded piece of the finite filtration of step 4 is zero. Successively each adjacent filtration inclusion is an isomorphism, and the filtration runs from $H^n$ to zero, so $H^n=0$. Hence $Rb_*K$ has constructible cohomology and cohomology support in $[a,c+2d]$; by [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] this is membership in $D^b_c(S,\Lambda)$.
